mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) directly elevates corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction (INDPRO decline), manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate capital expenditure and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflation that delays monetary policy easing and increases real interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.5%, it indicates a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 5.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust economic activity that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both increase, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary policy tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rise), the S&P 500 underperforms due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, causing negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
